name: SLOP
description: The $SLOP ERC-20 token, minted after a valid proof moves a locked Slonk into the void.
about:
## About $SLOP

$SLOP is the ERC-20 token of the Slonks ecosystem. It has 18 decimals and supports EIP-2612 permit. It is minted by authorized minters — primarily **SlopGameV2** (`0x76c61b6140600429f50de5ac987e41672047cc28`), the void game — after a valid proof moves a holder's locked Slonk into the void, with the amount driven by that token's slop. It relates to the **Slonks** NFT (`0x832233ddb7bcffd0ed53127dd6be3f1aa5845108`).

Minting is capped by a maximum supply, and the one-time launch inventory has already been minted. Authorized minters can also burn balances as part of Slonks game mechanics, so circulating and total supply change over time.
risks: The owner can authorize minters that may mint up to the supply cap and burn tokens from any specified holder without allowance
